titulo: A pile split into three colors
caption:
A pile split into three colors

A pile looks like one problem until you split it. Three colors, three piles, and the middle of it is finally visible.

Sorting takes two minutes, and the sorted pile stops being a thing you avoid.

For whoever splits the pile into three before tackling it.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A bedroom. A tall mixed pile of six colored shapes sits at the far right. A plum block figure with narrowed eyes at the left says it's all one pile. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers three piles, and the shapes slide out of the pile into three neat stacks on the floor, one orange, one yellow and one blue. The plum one's eyes go wide and says oh. now I see it. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me splitting the pile first.
